brief:
Spain has condemned settlers besieging several Palestinian families in the town of Qasra, located south of Nablus in the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The Spanish Foreign Ministry called for an immediate end to violence and intimidation campaigns perpetrated by settlers against Palestinians and demanded that authorities halt the broader pattern of impunity enabling such actions.

The statement reflects growing international concern over settler violence in Palestinian communities. Residents of Qasra have faced restrictions on movement and repeated harassment, with settlers conducting what rights monitors describe as coordinated campaigns of intimidation aimed at forcing Palestinians from their land.
